item.title: Fire at popular nightclub in India's Goa state leaves 25 dead
item.description: A fire ripped through a popular nightclub in India's Goa state, killing 25 people, including tourists, the state's chief minister said Sunday.

item.title: 2026 World Cup matches: Who's playing at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara?
item.description: Here's what we know about who's playing in the FIFA World Cup at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara in 2026.

item.title: Trump says he's hosting the Kennedy Center Honors gala recognizing Stallone, Kiss, Gaynor and others
item.description: Sylvester Stallone, Kiss, and Gloria Gaynor are among the luminaries being celebrated at the annual Kennedy Center Honors.

item.title: 1 killed, more than 20 poisoned by death cap mushrooms in California, officials say
item.description: California officials are warning foragers after an outbreak of poisoning linked to wild mushrooms that has killed one adult and caused severe liver damage in several patients, including children.

item.title: Pretrial hearing for Luigi Mangione to resume Monday after court releases new evidence in case
item.description: On Saturday, the court authorized an additional release of evidence, including a piece of paper with a to-do list, which prosecutors say was linked to the CEO murder.

item.title: Salmon spotted in Bay Area creek, marking return for 1st time in decades after restoration project
item.description: A restoration project we reported on is turning into a major environmental success story. Just weeks after our report, fish are being spotted in a scenic stretch of an East Bay watershed for the first time in decades.

item.title: SF plans to increase fines for dangerous dirt bike riding as crackdown intensifies
item.description: Groups of dirt bikers speeding through the city have become an increasingly common and frustrating sight for people around San Francisco. Now, the board of supervisors is moving forward with legislation to stop dangerous dirt bike riding.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Morning fog, afternoon sun tomorrow
item.description: Late tonight, we can expect fog from the Central Valley to once again spill into some North Bay and East Bay inland valley locations, along with a lingering morning chill. Overnight lows will be mainly in the lower 40s.

item.title: Top Armed Services Dem says boat strike video would show Republicans' description 'completely false'
item.description: The top Democrat on the House Armed Services Committee said Sunday that surveillance video of U.S. military strikes targeting an alleged drug trafficking vessel in the Caribbean Sea on Sept. 2 would contradict how Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and other Republicans have described it.

item.title: Social worker fatally stabbed at SF hospital remembered as 'devoted to his patients' by community
item.description: We're learning more about the death of a social worker at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, who died two days after being stabbed by a man identified as a patient. The victim is being remembered as a deeply caring person. The tragedy raises concerns about safety and security.
